title: Boneyard: Skeleton UI from Component Mapping

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Skeleton screens require maintaining a parallel version of your UI that breaks every time the real layout changes. Boneyard eliminates that by dynamically mapping your actual components and generating the loading placeholders automatically. No hard-coded heights, widths, or border radi.
